Definition: from G1040; made of linen (neuter a linen cloth):--fine linen.
BiblicalUsage: In Revelation we find býssinos, the word for made of fine linen. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe býssinos is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
